card.line: Solomon's Portico was a covered walkway, probably on the east side of the temple, where crowds gathered and the first believers met in Jerusalem.

moments.title: Peter speaks to the crowd
moments.text: After a man who had been begging was healed, the people ran to Peter and John in the walkway. Peter told them the man was made strong by faith in the name of Jesus, whom God raised from the dead.

moments.title: Signs and wonders
moments.text: The apostles did many signs and wonders among the people, and the believers gathered together in the walkway. More and more people came to believe in the Lord, and the sick were healed.
